## Problem

The Jira reconcile bridge re-posted the same comments every hourly pass because its PRIMARY
id-identity dedup skip was inert (`comment_ids` empty). REB-1861 reached Jira's 5000-comment cap.
This ticket is the CLEANUP of the duplicates that defect produced; the defect itself is fixed
under `irongrey-chubby-oxpecker` (`aa7b-5e47-6d3d-4615`, change 1957, merged).

The full plan narrative, method, and safety rationale are preserved verbatim in this ticket's
comments (moved there so the required `provenance:` lines fit under the 8,000-char cap).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] **Pre-deletion backup** of the FULL comment payload (id, ADF body, author accountId +
      display name, created) per issue, written and completeness-checked BEFORE any DELETE.

- [x] **Dry-run default.** Deletion requires an explicit `--execute`. The dry run prints, per
      issue: fetched/reported total, marked count, unmarked count, distinct-body count, the kept
      id per body, and the delete count, and writes a per-issue machine-readable plan artifact.

- [x] **Canary first.** Execute on ONE light issue, verify it fully, then proceed.
      **REB-1861 runs LAST** (largest and riskiest).

- [x] **Per-issue post-verification**: re-fetch and assert every distinct normalized body present
      before the run still has exactly one surviving copy, that the unmarked count is unchanged,
      and that the issue is below the cap.

- [x] Ambiguous cases are SKIPPED and reported, never guessed.

- [x] The reconcile-bridge workflow stays PAUSED for the whole operation and is NOT re-enabled
      by this ticket.

- [x] [non-codebase] Affected-issue list derived by the documented command from run 32403944666,
      written as an artifact, and the run covered exactly it (30 issues) —.
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — issue list derived from GitHub Actions run 32403944666, artifact retained outside the repo

- [x] [non-codebase] Per issue `len(fetched) == total` held and a backup existed BEFORE any DELETE
      — `complete=True` everywhere; `backup/<KEY>.json` for all 27 issues with deletions (150MB).
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — per-issue completeness gate and backups executed against live Jira before any DELETE

- [x] [non-codebase] Dry run produced and inspected before `--execute`
      recorded in full as a ticket comment).
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — dry-run output produced against live Jira and inspected before --execute

- [x] [non-codebase] Marker detection ran PRE-STRIP — 30,847 `marked` counted; detection on
      stripped text would report 0.
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — marker counted on live pre-strip ADF text returned by the Jira API

- [x] [non-codebase] Every DELETE honoured `Retry-After` on 429 — 713+ throttles absorbed, 0 failed
      deletions across 29,931 DELETEs.
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — throttle handling observed against live Jira rate limits during execution

- [x] [non-codebase] Every issue below the cap; REB-1861 5000 -> 79.
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — post-run comment counts read back from live Jira

- [x] [non-codebase] Post-deletion re-fetch shows zero missing distinct bodies and unchanged
      non-candidate counts, confirmed independently against the backups (MISSING=0 on all 27).
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — independent re-fetch from live Jira compared against pre-deletion backups

- [x] [non-codebase] Deletion log has one object per deletion: 29,931 lines in matching the delete count.
      provenance: environment=jira-cloud-production; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — append-only operator-local log written during live execution
